scope: Approved plum-and-neon controls, dispatch offer, accepted-order card, menus, map and area picker. Existing world and shopfront data preserved.
testedSource: Working tree committed with this report; final production asset index-BTW-pO6P.js
implementation: Native chunky SVG icons and layered glow, cream lettering, plum panels, gold GO, lavender BRAKE, turquoise FLY and green cruise-on state.
GO remains a held accelerator. Cruise is a separate forward-throttle toggle and releases on brake, overlays, interactions and interrupted input.
Flight control reads FLY, LAND or disabled LANDING from actual flight state.
Permanent ACT removed; held Collect, Hand over and Talk controls appear only when eligible.
Dispatch card shows the actual base reward, distinct approach and customer distances, order ID, total route and timer-after-collection note; Accept and Decline stay outside scrolling details.
Accepted card shows Pickup / Collect / Deliver progress, destination and confirmation toast. Shared theme extends to title, pause/settings, area picker and map.

browser.method: Supported in-app browser with visible controls and native timed presses. Desktop pointer. The QA boot only selects the touch interface before normal production Game startup; no teleport, hidden state mutation, simulation stepping or autopilot.
